report_name: Critical Flaws in Red Hat Quay Enable Full Registry and Supply Chain Attack

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: An SQL injection flaw (CVE-2026-110697) in the public-facing Quay container registry's namespace lookup function can be exploited by a low-privileged user to steal robot account tokens.

attack_patterns.name: Subvert Trust Controls
attack_patterns.description: An unauthenticated attacker can exploit CVE-2026-123710 to install a malicious, non-expiring service signing key into the Quay registry, subverting the trust model for repository access tokens.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The vulnerabilities in Red Hat Quay could be exploited to read, overwrite, and inject malicious code into any container image stored in the registry, leading to a compromise of the software supply chain.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-123710
vulnerabilities.description: A critical trust-key injection vulnerability in Red Hat Quay that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to install their own service signing key, granting them full read and write access to any repository.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-110697
vulnerabilities.description: A critical SQL injection vulnerability in the Red Hat Quay namespace lookup function that allows a low-privileged authenticated user to steal robot account tokens from other tenants.

indicators.name: Quay Service Signing Key Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Red Hat Quay Service Signing Key Injection Attempt
id: 2b1c9c8f-4f7e-4b9a-8c6d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the creation of new service signing keys in Red Hat Quay, which could indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-123710.
references:
  - https://aviatrix.ai/threat-research-center/critical-red-hat-quay-flaw-cve-2026-123710-cve-2026-110697-container-registry-compromise/
author: cyber.netsec.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1553
level: high
logsource:
  category: application
  product: quay
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: 'key_creation'
    key_type: 'service_signing'
  filter_legit:
    source_user: 'admin_user' # Placeholder for legitimate admin users
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
indicators.description: Detects the creation of new service signing keys in Red Hat Quay, which could indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-123710.

indicators.name: Quay SQL Injection Attempt
indicators.pattern:
title: Red Hat Quay SQL Injection Attempt
id: 9d8e7f6a-5b4c-4a3b-2c1d-0e9f8a7b6c5d
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects malformed SQL queries against the Quay database containing unexpected wildcards, which could indicate an SQL injection attempt related to CVE-2026-110697.
references:
  - https://aviatrix.ai/threat-research-center/critical-red-hat-quay-flaw-cve-2026-123710-cve-2026-110697-container-registry-compromise/
author: cyber.netsec.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: database
detection:
  selection:
    query|contains|all:
      - 'SELECT'
      - 'FROM repository'
      - 'LIKE'
    query|contains:
      - '%_'
      - '%%'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects malformed SQL queries against the Quay database containing unexpected wildcards, which could indicate an SQL injection attempt related to CVE-2026-110697.

indicators.name: Anomalous Quay Image Push
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Red Hat Quay Image Push
id: 8c7b6a5f-4d3c-4b2a-1c0b-9e8f7a6b5c4d
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects container images being pushed to a Quay repository from an unknown IP address or by an unusual account, which could indicate a supply chain attack after a compromise.
references:
  - https://aviatrix.ai/threat-research-center/critical-red-hat-quay-flaw-cve-2026-123710-cve-2026-110697-container-registry-compromise/
author: cyber.netsec.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: application
  product: quay
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: 'image_push'
  filter_known_ips:
    source_ip:
      - '10.0.0.0/8' # Placeholder for known good CI/CD runners and developer IPs
      - '172.16.0.0/12'
  condition: selection and not filter_known_ips
indicators.description: Detects container images being pushed to a Quay repository from an unknown IP address or by an unusual account, which could indicate a supply chain attack.
